description: Canonical policy for external real-time data sources used by the Cici Telegram bot. All sources are Tier C by default unless noted. Xavier may promote specific data points to Tier A/B via explicit annotation.
trust_tier_note: All external API responses are Tier C (unverified). Cici must annotate live data with [C] when presenting it as fact. Xavier may verify and promote to [A] or [B] via explicit confirmation.

sources.name: Brave Search
sources.description: Live web search and news headlines via the Brave Search API.

sources.name: OpenWeatherMap
sources.description: Current conditions, hourly, and daily weather forecasts.
sources.location_note: Xavier: set WEATHER_LOCATION to your city (e.g. 'New York,US') in your .env file.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage
sources.description: Stock quotes, crypto prices, forex rates, and market indicators.
sources.enabled_note: Disabled by default. Enable by setting FINANCIAL_DATA_API_KEY and updating enabled: true via proposal.

sources.name: BrewMind Governed Docs
sources.description: Reads directly from governed-state and docs/ in this repo. Tier A — canonical truth.

sources.name: Custom MCP Sources
sources.description: Any MCP-compatible API server added in the future. Trust tier defaults to C; override per-source via proposal.
sources.enabled_note: Stub for future MCP-compatible integrations. Enable via proposal when a specific MCP source is identified.

citation_rules.tier_c_disclaimer: External data is unverified (Tier C). Do not treat as confirmed fact without Xavier's verification.
citation_rules.promotion_path: Xavier confirms data → annotate [A] → optionally capture to Supabase with #decision or #insight
